slides.title: Instagram *bio* mein ye 4 cheezein. Warna profile visit = zero enquiry.
slides.sub: Log post dekh ke bio pe aate hain. 3 second mein decide karte hain.

slides.title: 1. *Kya* karte ho, *kahan*
slides.sub: "Dreams come true ✨" nahi. Seedha kaam aur sheher.

slides.title: 2. *Kiske liye*
slides.sub: Ek line jisse sahi customer ko lage "ye mere liye hai".
slides.box: Working women ke liye 45-min express services

slides.title: 3. Ek *proof*
slides.sub: Number ho to sach wala. Na ho to experience ya award.

slides.title: 4. *Ek* clear action
slides.sub: Link tree mein 10 links nahi. Ek button: WhatsApp pe booking.

caption:
Profile pe log aate hain, aur 3 second mein chale jaate hain. Kyunki bio mein likha hai "Dreams come true ✨". 📱

Bio formula:
1️⃣ Kya karte ho + kahan
2️⃣ Kiske liye
3️⃣ Ek sach wala proof
4️⃣ Ek action: WhatsApp booking link

Save karo 🔖
